title: Build a private validation corpus from explicit owner labels
preconditions: Every label supplies a transaction ID plus an expected outcome kind and any required expected category ID; an explicit owner-local output path is supplied; a fresh complete Ledger classification_v1 evaluation projection is available.
postconditions: The destination is a 0600 owner-owned regular file inside a 0700 owner-owned non-symlink directory; every row comes from one explicit label and one fresh projection member; the file is accepted by the existing private-corpus reader; stdout and logs contain no descriptions, amounts, rows, labels, or path.
main_flow: The caller submits labels on stdin to classify.corpus.build; CLASSIFY validates bounds and label consistency, drains one fresh Ledger projection, binds every label to exactly one projection row, writes canonical JSONL to a same-directory owner-only temporary file, flushes and atomically renames it to a new regular destination, and returns aggregate metadata and fingerprints only.
alt_flows: Reject missing, duplicate, invented, inconsistent, oversized, or projection-absent labels with no destination file.
Reject symlink, non-regular, existing destination, non-owner, or permissive parent/destination boundaries before writing private rows.
On cancellation, write failure, flush failure, or crash before rename, leave no partial destination and recover or safely clean only the recognized same-directory temporary artifact.
metadata: {"depth_tier":3,"primary_actor":"P1","trigger":"The owner has an explicit bounded set of transaction labels and needs a correctly bound private JSONL corpus for classify.rule.validate.","status":"draft"}
